lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak mil sa(n)tasa(n)gat te magan bhae liv laaee ||2||25||48||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, joining the Society of the Saints, I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to my Lord. ||2||25||48||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa meet suaamee gaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Sing of your Lord and Master, your Best Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aas na avar kaahoo kee keejai sukhadaataa prabh dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Do not place your hopes in anyone else; meditate on God, the Giver of peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan jisahi ghar tis hee saranee paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Peace, joy and salvation are in His Home. Seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi tiaag maanukh je sevahu tau laaj lon hoi jaaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: But if you forsake Him, and serve mortal beings, your honor will dissolve like salt in water. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਓਟ ਪਕਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek ot pakaree thaakur kee gur mil mat budh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: I have grasped the Anchor and Support of my Lord and Master; meeting with the Guru, I have found wisdom and understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੨੬॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan naanak prabh miliaa sagal chukee muhataaeeai ||2||26||49||
lines.translation: Nanak has met God, the Treasure of Excellence; all dependence on others is gone. ||2||26||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ot sataanee prabh jeeu merai ||
lines.translation: I have the Almighty Support of my Dear Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਲਿਆਵਉ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਮਾਣਿ ਮਹਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: drisat na liaavau avar kaahoo kau maan mahat prabh terai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I do not look up to anyone else. My honor and glory are Yours, O God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apunai kaadh leeaa bikh gherai ||
lines.translation: God has taken my side; He has lifted me up and pulled me out of the whirlpool of corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam aukhadh mukh deeno jaai paiaa gur pairai ||1||
lines.translation: He has poured the medicine of the Naam, the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, into my mouth; I have fallen at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹਉ ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan upamaa kahau ek mukh niragun ke daaterai ||
lines.translation: How can I praise You with only one mouth? You are generous, even to the unworthy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: kaat silak jau apunaa keeno naanak sookh ghanerai ||2||27||50||
lines.translation: You cut away the noose, and now You own me; Nanak is blessed with myriad joys. ||2||27||50||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh simarat dookh binaasee ||
lines.translation: Remembering God in meditation, pains are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਖਲਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio kripaal jee sukhadaataa hoee sagal khalaasee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When the Giver of peace to the soul becomes merciful, the mortal is totally redeemed. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਸੂਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹੁ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar na kooo soojhai prabh bin kahu ko kis pahi jaasee ||
lines.translation: I know of none other than God; tell me, who else should I approach?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu raakhahu thaakur sabh kichh tum hee paasee ||1||
lines.translation: As You know me, so do You keep me, O my Lord and Master.I have surrendered everything to You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: haath dei raakhe prabh apune sad jeevan abinaasee ||
lines.translation: God gave me His Hand and saved me; He has blessed me with eternal life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥੨੮॥੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak man anad bhaiaa hai kaatee jam kee phaasee ||2||28||51||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, my mind is in ecstasy; the noose of death has been cut away from my neck. ||2||28||51||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mero man jat kat tujhahi samhaarai ||
lines.translation: My mind contemplates You, O Lord, all the time.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਪਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham baarik deen pitaa prabh mere jiu jaanahi tiu paarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am Your meek and helpless child; You are God my Father. As You know me, You save me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਭੁਖੌ ਤਬ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਅਘਾਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਘਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab bhukhau tab bhojan maa(n)gai aghaae sookh saghaarai ||
lines.translation: When I am hungry, I ask for food; when I am full, I am totally at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਅਰੋਗ ਜਬ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੌ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tab arog jab tum sa(n)g basatau chhutakat hoi ravaarai ||1||
lines.translation: When I dwell with You, I am free of disease; if I become separated from You, I turn to dust. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਥਾਪਿਉ ਥਾਪਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan basero daas daasan ko thaapiu thaapanahaarai ||
lines.translation: What power does the slave of Your slave have, O Establisher and Disestablisher?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਤਬ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam na bisarai tab jeevan paaeeai binatee naanak ih saarai ||2||29||52||
lines.translation: If I do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, then I die. Nanak offers this prayer. ||2||29||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: man te bhai bhau door paraaio ||
lines.translation: I have shaken off fear and dread from my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਲਾਲ ਲਾਡਿਲੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: laal daiaal gulaal laadile sahaj sahaj gun gaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: With intuitive ease, peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Kind, Sweet, Darling Beloved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bachanaat kamaat kripaa te bahur na katahoo dhaaio ||
lines.translation: Practicing the Guru's Word, by His Grace, I do not wander anywhere anymore.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: rahat upaadh samaadh sukh aasan bhagat vachhal grihi paaio ||1||
lines.translation: The illusion has been dispelled; I am in Samaadhi, Sukh-aasan, the position of peace. I have found the Lord, the Lover of His devotees, within the home of my own heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋਡ ਆਨੰਦਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: naad binod kod aana(n)daa sahaje sahaj samaaio ||
lines.translation: | The Sound-current of the Naad, playful joys and pleasures - I am intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: karanaa aap karaavan aape kahu naanak aap aapaaio ||2||30||53||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Creator, the Cause of causes. Says Nanak, He Himself is All-in-all. ||2||30||53||
